name: Track Vinted UK search matches and price changes in Google Sheets

parameters.content:
## Track Vinted UK search matches in Google Sheets

Keep a shortlist of second-hand listings that match a public Vinted UK search. This workflow helps buyers and resellers compare observed prices and condition changes without repeatedly copying listings into a spreadsheet. It does not buy items or estimate resale profit.

### How it works
One bounded Apify run reads up to 24 listings from your catalog URL, including its brand, size, condition and price filters. A stable watch tracks newly observed listings and factual price or condition changes. First-run matches are labelled NEW even if posted earlier. The workflow verifies source and billing receipts before upserting one Sheet row per listing and watch scope. CAPPED means only a bounded sample was checked; it never proves an unseen item disappeared. Failed or partial checks stop delivery. Existing observations remain in the Sheet with their last observation time. The Sheet stores latest observations, not a complete inventory or event history.

### Setup
1. Create an Apify Header Auth credential: name Authorization, value Bearer followed by your token. Select it on all four HTTP nodes.
2. Connect Google Sheets OAuth2. Create a Vinted Watch tab with the supplied CSV headers and keep upsertKey as the only matching column.
3. Enter your spreadsheet ID and filtered UK catalog URL in Listing watch settings. The Nike example is a starting point; only supported public filter parameters are accepted.
4. Run manually and inspect the result before repeating sequentially. Keep the watch name and filters stable.
5. Apify usage is paid, including unchanged verified listings. The default $0.10 cap limits Actor charges. No credits, Telegram alerts or automatic purchases are included.

## 1. Configure
Set one public UK catalog URL and your Sheet destination. Keep the watch name stable. Validation rejects unsupported filters before paid work.

## 2. Run once and wait
Only the first HTTP call starts an Actor. Polling reads the existing run; failures stop before any Sheet write.

## 3. Verify output
Check source coverage, billing receipts and dataset size. CAPPED is an observed sample; partial or failed checks stop delivery. Read every record before writing.

## 4. Update your register
Update one row per listing and watch scope. Preserve last-observed timestamps and coverage labels. Only Sheets may retry; no paid Actor retry.
